name: Bufoviridine
summary: Bufoviridine, also known as bufotenine O-sulfate, dihydrobufothionine, or 5-sulfooxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (5-sulfooxy-DMT or 5-SO-DMT), is a naturally occurring tryptamine found in Bufo species such as Bufo viridis and Bufo calamita. It is the O-sulfate ester of bufotenin (5-HO-DMT). The compound shows very weak serotonergic activity.

pharmacology.text: The compound shows very weak serotonergic activity.

uses.en: It is not used as a drug. It is of interest to researchers studying toad skin chemistry and the tryptamines.
uses.zh: 它不作為藥物使用，主要引起研究蟾蜍皮膚化學與色胺類物質的研究人員的興趣。
uses.zhHans: 它不作为药物使用，主要引起研究蟾蜍皮肤化学与色胺类物质的研究人员的兴趣。

sideEffects.en: It shows only very weak activity at serotonin receptors and has not been studied in people, so its effects there are unknown.
sideEffects.zh: 它在血清素受體上的活性極弱，也未曾在人體研究過，因此對人的影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在血清素受体上的活性极弱，也未曾在人体研究过，因此对人的影响不明。

fact.en: It is bufotenin with a sulphate group attached, found in toads of the Bufo genus. Adding a sulphate is one of the ways living things package a compound to make it water soluble and easy to store or excrete.
fact.zh: 它是蟾毒色胺接上硫酸基的產物，存在於 Bufo 屬蟾蜍體內。加上硫酸基是生物把化合物變得水溶、便於儲存或排出的方式之一。
fact.zhHans: 它是蟾毒色胺接上硫酸基的产物，存在于 Bufo 属蟾蜍体内。加上硫酸基是生物把化合物变得水溶、便于保存或排出的方式之一。
